Security.Note: ⚠️ WARNING: Do not commit real passwords to source control!
Instructions: 1. For development: Create appsettings.Development.json with your local credentials (already in .gitignore)
2. For production: Use environment variables or Azure Key Vault/AWS Secrets Manager
3. Environment variables override appsettings: CONNECTIONSTRINGS__DEVCONNECTION or CONNECTIONSTRINGS__PRODCONNECTION
